headline: Before the Holiday, a V-Shaped Reversal! Here Is the New Policy Interpretation
summary: On the last trading day before the National Day holiday, Vanke A hit the limit down at the open and the real estate index fell about 5% intraday. Declines then gradually eased.
why: Vanke is one of China's largest property developers, and its share price reflects the health of China's real estate sector, which matters for the broader economy and credit markets.
why_moved: The real estate index dropped sharply at the open, with Vanke A hitting its limit down, before the decline gradually narrowed.
